title: 九孔桥 Jiukong Qiao
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 麴院風荷之南跨池東西橋九空坊楔二西為金鼇東為玉蝀金鼇西南河外室為四圍佳麗玉蝀東有亭為飲練長虹又東南度橋折而北設城闗為寧和鎮其東南為東樓門（圓明園册）臣等謹按飲練長虹寧和鎮諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: South of 麴院風荷, a nine-opening bridge across the pool with archways 金鼇 to the west and 玉蝀 to the east; 四圍佳麗 and the 飲練長虹 pavilion nearby; further south-east the walled mock town 寧和鎮 and the 東樓門.

evidence.title: Scene 39, 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe
evidence.excerpt_other: The building at the Yuan Ming Yuan which bore this name faced south on a pretty lotus pond crossed by a great curved bridge supported by nine arches and leading nowhere in particular.
evidence.summary: Hall facing south on a lotus pond with a nine-arch curved bridge.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label: a building stood here, its name unknown.
